description: A lightweight .NET 8 message bus library with pluggable transports (InMemory and Azure Service Bus). Supports fire-and-forget publish, request/response, multi-bus, JSON serialization, and MassTransit-inspired architecture with Exchange/Queue fabric, scoped DI consumer resolution, and IHostedService…
Local MCP server that puts a statement guard, an optional read-only mode and an audit log between an AI agent and your SQL Server.
